external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Presented by Agemark Senior Living and Agemark Communities in Omaha and Lincoln, including Astoria, CountryHouse and Symphony Pointe, along with the Alzheimer’s Association of Nebraska, you’ll learn about: Tools to Support Your Loved One’s Independence, Effective Communication Techniques, Exploring Care & Support Services and more. A lunchtime keynote address will feature PAC Certified Dementia Consultant Gayleen Bradley sharing her personal story and offering advice to fellow caregivers.

There will also be an optional pre and post-conference opportunity to take the Virtual Dementia Tour. Second Wind Dreams, in partnership with Agemark Senior Living Certified Trainers, will host the tour for those who are interested. Spaces for the VDT are very limited.

Agemark Senior Living and National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE:NHI) have partnered on financing for six memory care communities with 205 units in Nebraska. NHI will provide a long-term financing structure for the building, and Agemark will maintain 100% control of operations. This deal reinforces Agemark’s strategy of owning and operating senior living communities on a long-term basis with a partner that aligns with Agemark’s mission and vision.

Agemark Senior Living, an industry leader in creating home-like senior communities for more than three decades, was recently appointed as the managing entity of three senior living communities in California: Sage Glendale in Glendale, CA; Sage Mountain in Thousand Oaks, CA; and Kingston Bay in Fresno, Bay. Sage Detect is the latest advancement in our partnership with Sage, the senior care platform built specifically for communities like ours. Originally developed as a next-generation nurse call system, Sage has evolved into a comprehensive, cloud-based platform that helps caregivers manage, document, and respond to care needs in real time. With this new enhancement, Sage Detect takes care to the next level.

With $59M in funding, most recently a $35M Series B in December 2024, Sage is backed by investors including IVP, Friends & Family Capital, PLUS Capital, Maveron, Goldcrest Capital, Distributed Ventures, and ANIMO Ventures. They are excited to announce that Matthew and Camila McConaughey have also invested in Sage.
